column1: # Frozen C4 leave-zero-out settings for the held-out cohort (review round 5). Committed after the
# development ladder and before any held-out donor is simulated, run or examined.
# Selected by scripts/select_genotype_ladder.py from the eight-donor LZO ladder run at commit 28bbc3e
# (clean worktree; state limits 256/1024/4096, K prefixes 8-256): the smallest (state limit, K) whose
# every setting above it in both dimensions completed with the reference winner and block calls, for
# every development donor. The ladder chose it without reading truth distance.
# audit_candidates is declared here, before the cohort, and is not a setting: the same proposal is also
# ranked at K = 256 and reported separately, only to measure whether the K = 8 winner, block calls and
# READS phase support survive a larger candidate set. On the development donors READS phase at small K
# was not always stable (HG04036: READS at K 8-16, PRIOR_ONLY from K 32). It never changes a primary call.
